part-of.description: Note whose title matches a sub-topic of the parent folder, or a folder-level hierarchical relationship.
signals: note lives in folder whose name is a superclass of the note's topic
target note is the folder's index note
note describes a person/work/event; target is the general category (e.g., Einstein → Physicist)

generalizes.description: Abstraction of a more concrete concept.
signals: note's title is a broad category; target is a specific case

supports.description: Two related notes in the same topic area, neither hierarchically above the other.
signals: both notes tagged with the same primary keyword
both cited in each other's 'See also' sections
source text mentions 'based on', 'building on', 'derived from', 'influenced by'
target is a chronologically earlier note
source text uses 'led to', 'caused', 'resulted in', 'gave rise to'
